search_index.title: Qwen-Long-大模型服务平台百炼(Model Studio)-阿里云帮助中心
search_index.description: 处理超长文本文档时，标准大型语言模型会因上下文窗口限制而失败。Qwen-Long 模型提供 1000 万 Token 的上下文长度，通过文件上传和引用机制处理大规模数据。
search_index.content: Qwen-Long-大模型服务平台百炼(Model Studio)-阿里云帮助中心 官方文档 处理超长文本文档时，标准大型语言模型会因上下文窗口限制而失败。Qwen-Long 模型提供 1000 万 Token 的上下文长度，通过文件上传和引用机制处理大规模数据。 说明 本文档仅适用于华北 2（北京）地域。如需使用模型，需使用华北 2（北京）地域的 API Key 。 使用方式 Qwen-Long 处理长文档分为以下两个步骤：文件上传与 API 调用。 文件上传与解析： 通过 API 上传文件，文件格式与大小限制请参考 支持格式 。 上传并成功后，系统返回一个当前账号下的 唯一 file-id 并开始解析。文件上传、存储以及解析本身不产生费用。 API 调用与计费： 在调用模型时，通过在 system 消息中引用一个或多个 file-id 。 模型根据 file-id 关联的文本内容进行推理。 每次 API 调用都会将所引用文件内容 Token 数计入该次请求的 输入 Token 。 此机制避免了在每次请求中传输庞大的文件内容，但需留意其计费方式。 快速开始 前提条件 已 获取与配置 API Key ，并 配置 API Key 到环境变量 。 如果通过 SDK 调用，还需要安装 OpenAI SDK 。 文档上传 以 阿里云百炼系列手机产品介绍.docx 为例，通过 OpenAI 兼容接口上传到阿里云百炼平台的安全存储空间，获取返回的 file-id 。有关文档上传接口的详细参数解释及调用方式，请参考 API 文档 页面进行了解。 Python import os from pathlib import Path from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY"), # 如果您没有配置环境变量，请在此处替换您的API-KEY # 以下为华北2（北京）地域的URL，各地域的URL不同。 base_url="https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1", # 填写DashScope服务base_url ) file_object = client.files.create(file=Path("阿里云百炼系列手机产品介绍.docx"), purpose="file-extract") print(file_object.id) Java import com.openai.client.OpenAIClient; import com.openai.client.okhttp.OpenAIOkHttpClient; import com.openai.models.files.*; import java.nio.file.Path; import java.nio.file.Paths; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { // 创建客户端，使用环境变量中的API密钥 OpenAIClient client = OpenAIOkHttpClient.builder() // 若没有配置环境变量，请用百炼API Key将下行替换为：.apiKey("sk-xxx") .apiKey(System.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY")) // 以下为华北2（北京）地域的URL，各地域的URL不同。 .baseUrl("https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1") .build(); // 设置文件路径,请根据实际需求修改路径与文件名 Path filePath = Paths.get("src/main/java/org/example/阿里云百炼系列手机产品介绍.docx"); // 创建文件上传参数 FileCreateParams fileParams = FileCreateParams.builder() .file(filePath) .purpose(FilePurpose.of("file-extract")) .build(); // 上传文件打印fileid FileObject fileObject = client.files().create(fileParams); System.out.println(fileObject.id()); } } curl curl --location --request POST 'https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/files' \ --header "Authorization: Bearer $DASHSCOPE_API_KEY" \ --form 'file=@"阿里云百炼系列手机产品介绍.docx"' \ --form 'purpose="file-extract"' 运行以上代码，您可以得到本次上传文件对应的 file-id 。 通过文件 ID 传入信息并对话 将获取的 file-id 嵌入到 System Message 中。第一条 System Message 用于设定角色向模型提问，后续的 System Message 用于传入 file-id ，User Message 包含针对文档的具体问题。 较长的文档可能会需要相对更长的时间完成解析，请耐心等待解析完成后进行调用。 Python import os from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError client = OpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY"), # 如果您没有配置环境变量，请在此处替换您的API-KEY # 以下为华北2（北京）地域的URL，各地域的URL不同。 base_url="https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1", # 填写DashScope服务base_url ) try: # 初始化messages列表 completion = client.chat.completions.create( model="qwen-long", messages=[ # sys1: 角色定义 {'role': 'system', 'content': 'You are a helpful assistant.'}, # sys2: 文档内容（纯文本或file-id） # 请将 '{FILE_ID}'替换为您实际对话场景所使用的 fileid {'role': 'system', 'content': f'fileid://{FILE_ID}'}, # 当请求中包含第 2 条system message时，user消息内容长度限制在 9,000 Token 以内 {'role': 'user', 'content': '这篇文章讲了什么?'} ], # 所有代码示例均采用流式输出，以清晰和直观地展示模型输出过程。如果您希望查看非流式输出的案例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/text-generation stream=True, stream_options={"include_usage": True} ) full_content = "" for chunk in completion: if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content: # 拼接输出内容 full_content += chunk.choices[0].delta.content print(chunk.model_dump()) # 获取 token 使用情况 if chunk.usage: print(f"总计 tokens: {chunk.usage.total_tokens}") print(full_content) except BadRequestError as e: print(f"错误信息：{e}") print("请参考文档：https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/error-code") Java import com.openai.client.OpenAIClient; import com.openai.client.okhttp.OpenAIOkHttpClient; import com.openai.core.http.StreamResponse; import com.openai.models.chat.completions.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { // 创建客户端，使用环境变量中的API密钥 OpenAIClient client = OpenAIOkHttpClient.builder() // 若没有配置环境变量，请用百炼API Key将下行替换为：.apiKey("sk-xxx") .apiKey(System.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY")) // 以下为华北2（北京）地域的URL，各地域的URL不同。 .baseUrl("https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1") .build(); // 创建聊天请求 ChatCompletionCreateParams chatParams = ChatCompletionCreateParams.builder() //sys1: 角色定义 .addSystemMessage("You are a helpful assistant.") //sys2: 文档内容（纯文本或file-id） //请将 '{FILE_ID}'替换为您实际对话场景所使用的 fileid。 .addSystemMessage("fileid://{FILE_ID}") //当请求中包含第 2 条system message时，user消息内容长度限制在 9,000 Token 以内 .addUserMessage("这篇文章讲了什么？") .model("qwen-long") .build(); StringBuilder fullResponse = new StringBuilder(); // 所有代码示例均采用流式输出，以清晰和直观地展示模型输出过程。如果您希望查看非流式输出的案例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/text-generation try (StreamResponse<ChatCompletionChunk> streamResponse = client.chat().completions().createStreaming(chatParams)) { streamResponse.stream().forEach(chunk -> { // 打印每个 chunk 的内容并拼接 System.out.println(chunk); String content = chunk.choices().get(0).delta().content().orElse(""); if (!content.isEmpty()) { fullResponse.append(content); } }); System.out.println(fullResponse); } catch (Exception e) { System.err.println("错误信息：" + e.getMessage()); System.err.println("请参考文档：https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/error-code"); } } } curl curl --location 'https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions' \ --header "Authorization: Bearer $DASHSCOPE_API_KEY" \ --header "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "model": "qwen-long", "messages": [ {"role": "system","content": "You are a helpful assistant."}, {"role": "system","content": "fileid://file-fe-xxx"}, {"role": "user","content": "这篇文章讲了什么？"} ], "stream": true, "stream_options": { "include_usage": true } }' 传入多个文档 您可以在一条 System Message 中传入多个 file-id ，以便在一次请求中处理多个文档；也可以在 messages 中添加新的 System Message 以补充新的文档信息。 传入多文档 Python import os from openai import OpenAI, BadRequestError client = OpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY"), # 如果您没有配置环境变量，请在此处替换您的API-KEY # 以下为华北2（北京）地域的URL，各地域的URL不

Create GitHub issue for staff review Abstract In the era of large language models, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a promising architecture for managing computational costs when scaling up model parameters. However, conventional MoE architectures like GShard, which activate the top- K out of N experts, face challenges in ensuring expert specialization, i.e. each expert acquires non-overlapping and focused knowledge. In response, we propose the DeepSeekMoE architecture towards ultimate expert specialization. It involves two principal strategies: (1) finely segmenting the experts into mN ones and activating mK from them, allowing for a more flexible combination of activated experts; (2) isolating K s experts as shared ones, aiming at capturing common knowledge and mitigating redundancy in routed experts. Starting from a modest scale with 2B parameters, we demonstrate that DeepSeekMoE 2B achieves comparable performance with GShard 2.9B, which has 1.5 × expert parameters and computation. In addition, DeepSeekMoE 2B nearly approaches the performance of its dense counterpart with the same number of total parameters, which sets the upper bound of MoE models. Subsequently, we scale up DeepSeekMoE to 16B parameters and show that it achieves comparable performance with DeepSeek 7B and LLaMA2 7B, with only about 40% of computations. search_index.description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2401.18058: LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models
search_index.content: [2401.18058] LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models Skip to main content Search arXiv Press Enter to search · Advanced search --> Computer Science > Computation and Language arXiv:2401.18058 (cs) [Submitted on 31 Jan 2024] Title: LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models Authors: Yushi Bai , Xin Lv , Jiajie Zhang , Yuze He , Ji Qi , Lei Hou , Jie Tang , Yuxiao Dong , Juanzi Li View a PDF of the paper titled LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models, by Yushi Bai and 8 other authors View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: Extending large language models to effectively handle long contexts requires instruction fine-tuning on input sequences of similar length. To address this, we present LongAlign -- a recipe of the instruction data, training, and evaluation for long context alignment. First, we construct a long instruction-following dataset using Self-Instruct. To ensure the data diversity, it covers a broad range of tasks from various long context sources. Second, we adopt the packing and sorted batching strategies to speed up supervised fine-tuning on data with varied length distributions. Additionally, we develop a loss weighting method to balance the contribution to the loss across different sequences during packing training. Third, we introduce the LongBench-Chat benchmark for evaluating instruction-following capabilities on queries of 10k-100k in length. Experiments show that LongAlign outperforms existing recipes for LLMs in long context tasks by up to 30\%, while also maintaining their proficiency in handling short, generic tasks. The code, data, and long-aligned models are open-sourced at this https URL . To achieve efficient inference and cost-effective training, DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2. Furthermore, DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing and sets a multi-token prediction training objective for stronger performance. We pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8 trillion diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning stages to fully harness its capabilities. Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models. Despite its excellent performance, DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training. In addition, its training process is remarkably stable. Throughout the entire training process, we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks. The model checkpoints are available at this https URL . search_index.description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2412.15204: LongBench v2: Towards Deeper Understanding and Reasoning on Realistic Long-context Multitasks
search_index.content: [2412.15204] LongBench v2: Towards Deeper Understanding and Reasoning on Realistic Long-context Multitasks Skip to main content Search arXiv Press Enter to search · Advanced search --> Computer Science > Computation and Language arXiv:2412.15204 (cs) [Submitted on 19 Dec 2024 ( v1 ), last revised 3 Jan 2025 (this version, v2)] Title: LongBench v2: Towards Deeper Understanding and Reasoning on Realistic Long-context Multitasks Authors: Yushi Bai , Shangqing Tu , Jiajie Zhang , Hao Peng , Xiaozhi Wang , Xin Lv , Shulin Cao , Jiazheng Xu , Lei Hou , Yuxiao Dong , Jie Tang , Juanzi Li View a PDF of the paper titled LongBench v2: Towards Deeper Understanding and Reasoning on Realistic Long-context Multitasks, by Yushi Bai and 11 other authors View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: This paper introduces LongBench v2, a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to handle long-context problems requiring deep understanding and reasoning across real-world multitasks. LongBench v2 consists of 503 challenging multiple-choice questions, with contexts ranging from 8k to 2M words, across six major task categories: single-document QA, multi-document QA, long in-context learning, long-dialogue history understanding, code repository understanding, and long structured data understanding. To ensure the breadth and the practicality, we collect data from nearly 100 highly educated individuals with diverse professional backgrounds. We employ both automated and manual review processes to maintain high quality and difficulty, resulting in human experts achieving only 53.7% accuracy under a 15-minute time constraint. Our evaluation reveals that the best-performing model, when directly answers the questions, achieves only 50.1% accuracy. In contrast, the o1-preview model, which includes longer reasoning, achieves 57.7%, surpassing the human baseline by 4%. These results highlight the importance of enhanced reasoning ability and scaling inference-time compute to tackle the long-context challenges in LongBench v2. The project is available at this https URL . search_index.content: [2310.05029] Walking Down the Memory Maze: Beyond Context Limit through Interactive Reading Skip to main content Search arXiv Press Enter to search · Advanced search --> Computer Science > Computation and Language arXiv:2310.05029 (cs) [Submitted on 8 Oct 2023] Title: Walking Down the Memory Maze: Beyond Context Limit through Interactive Reading Authors: Howard Chen , Ramakanth Pasunuru , Jason Weston , Asli Celikyilmaz View a PDF of the paper titled Walking Down the Memory Maze: Beyond Context Limit through Interactive Reading, by Howard Chen and 3 other authors View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced in large strides due to the effectiveness of the self-attention mechanism that processes and compares all tokens at once. However, this mechanism comes with a fundamental issue -- the predetermined context window is bound to be limited. Despite attempts to extend the context window through methods like extrapolating the positional embedding, using recurrence, or selectively retrieving essential parts of the long sequence, long-text understanding continues to be a challenge. We propose an alternative approach which instead treats the LLM as an interactive agent, allowing it to decide how to read the text via iterative prompting. We introduce MemWalker, a method that first processes the long context into a tree of summary nodes. Upon receiving a query, the model navigates this tree in search of relevant information, and responds once it gathers sufficient information. On long-text question answering tasks our method outperforms baseline approaches that use long context windows, recurrence, and retrieval. We show that, beyond effective reading, MemWalker enhances explainability by highlighting the reasoning steps as it interactively reads the text; pinpointing the relevant text segments related to the query. Dismiss alert {{ message }} main Branches Tags Go to file Code Open more actions menu Latest commit History 7 Commits 7 Commits Folders and files Name Name Last commit message Last commit date assets assets examples examples src src README.md README.md requirements.txt requirements.txt setup.py setup.py View all files Repository files navigation QwenLong-CPRS: Towards ∞-LLMs with Dynamic Context Optimization Weizhou Shen, Chenliang Li, Fanqi Wan, Shengyi Liao, Shaopeng Lai, Bo Zhang, Yingcheng Shi, Yuning Wu, Gang Fu, Zhansheng Li, Bin Yang,Ji Zhang, Fei Huang, Jingren Zhou, Ming Yan * Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group 📚 Introduction In this work, we present QwenLong-CPRS, a novel framework designed to optimize long-context processing through query-aware multi-granularity compression, outperforming RAG and sparse attention methods. Distinct from RAG's coarse chunk-level retrieval, it achieves precise information extraction via token-level content selection, enhancing accuracy. Unlike sparse attention (SA) requiring model retraining, it functions as a plug-and-play module compatible with any downstream LLMs while eliminating retraining demands. This dual advantage enables both fine-grained context optimization and seamless integration across architectures. We implement QwenLong-CPRS with four key innovations: Controllable Context Optimization : Processes control prompts + queries to generate compact, task-specific context segments without retraining. Hybrid Attention Architecture : Combines bi-directional modeling (context localization) with causal LM (representation fidelity). LM-as-Critic Framework : Repurposes the pretrained LM head to score token relevance, preserving original knowledge while enabling compression. Window-Parrallel Inference : Splits long context into $w$ -sized windows for parallel processing, reducing prefill complexity. 🎉 News May 26, 2025: 🔥 We release 🤗 QwenLong-CPRS-7B , a 7B context compression model designed for explicit long-context optimization. 🔥 Key Achievements : ✅ Superior Performance : Outperforms RAG and sparse attention in both accuracy and efficiency across five long-context benchmarks. ✅ Universal Compatibility : Seamlessly integrates with all flagship LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0-pro, Claude 3.7-sonnet, DeepSeek-v3, Qwen2.5-max), achieving 21.59× context compression and +19.15 avg. performance boost. ✅ New SOTA : When paired with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, it surpasses top proprietary models by +4.85 on Ruler-128K and +10.88 on InfiniteBench, setting a new SOTA. May 24, 2025: 🔥 We release the 💻 Demo Code for deploying the QwenLong-CPRS API and runing simpling long-context tasks with QwenLong-CPRS cascading an LLM. 🎯 Model Results Here are the evaluation results. 🛠️ Requirements # Create the conda environment conda create -n qwenlong-cprs python==3.10 conda activate qwenlong-cprs # Install verl cd QwenLong-CPRS pip3 install -e . 🚀 Quick Start Here we provide how to run QwenLong-CPRS with LLM in a long-context task: Step 1: Deploy local QwenLong-CPRS API cd QwenLong-CPRS/src/api_utils export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 export MODEL_DIR= " Tongyi-Zhiwen/QwenLong-CPRS-7B " uvicorn run_api:app --port 8091 --host ' 0.0.0.0 ' --workers 1 Step 2: Data Preparation Download Ruler-128K test data from huggingface-hub and put it on the data folder. Step 3: Run the demo inference code cd QwenLong-CPRS/examples export LLM_APIKEY= " " # your llm api key export LLM_APIURL= " " # your llm api url # for NIAH tasks export CPRS_PROMPT= " You are an expert for information extraction, your task is to extract the 'needles' in the format of 'One of the special magic {type_needle_v} for {key} is: {value}.' from the documents to answer user's question.\N## tagging rule:
- tag the needles with 'needle' " python infer.py \ --model " your LLM model name " \ --input_path " data/niah.jsonl " \ --output_path " output/llm_with_cprs/niah.jsonl " \ --cprs_prompt " $CPRS_PROMPT " \ --use_compress True # for qa tasks export CPRS_PROMPT= " You are an expert for information extraction, your task is to extract some sentences from the documents as the supporting facts of the user's question.
## tagging rule:
- tag the supporting facts with 'fact' " python infer.py \ --model " your LLM model name " \ --input_path " data/qa.jsonl " \ --output_path " output/llm_with_cprs/niah.jsonl " \ --cprs_prompt " $CPRS_PROMPT " \ --use_compress True # for variable tracking tasks export CPRS_PROMPT= " You are an expert for information extraction, your task is to extract the assigment chains like 'VAR XXX1 = XXX2' from the documents to answer the question of the user.
## tagging rule:
- tag the assignment chains with 'chain' " python infer.py \ --model " your LLM model name " \ --input_path " data/qa.jsonl " \ --output_path " output/llm_with_cprs/niah.jsonl " \ --cprs_prompt " $CPRS_PROMPT " \ --use_compress True 🌐 Join the Community Chinese users can scan QR codes to join DingTalk/WeChat groups. However, the existing packet loss concealment (PLC) algorithms are hard to generate high-quality speech signal while maintaining low computationalcomplexity. In this paper, a causal wave-to-wave non-autoregressive lightweight PLC model(PLCNet) is proposed, which can do real-time streaming process with low latency. In addition, we introduce multiple multi-resolution discriminators and semi-supervised training strategy to improve the ability of the encoder part to extract global features while enabling the decoder part to accurately reconstruct waveforms where packets are lost. Contrary to autoregressive model, PLCNet can guarantee the smoothness and continuity of the speech phase before and after packet loss without any smoothing operations. Experimental results show that PLCNet achieves significant improvements in perceptual quality and intelligibility over three classical PLC methods and three state-of-the-art deep PLC methods. In the INTERSPEECH 2022 PLC Challenge, our approach has ranked the 3rd place on PLCMOS(3.829) and the 3rd place on the final score (0.798). Index Terms: packet loss concealment, generative adversarial network, semi-supervised, non-autoregressive, low complexity 1.Introduction In VOIP communication, speech signal is transmitted as packets over the network through encoding and compression technology. However, due to the influence of the network environment, some audio packets cannot be transmitted to the receiver, resulting in short-term interruption of the speech signal, whichdinnturnaffectscals sPeechqualityand intelligibility during long-term calls. To solve the above problems, the PLC algorithm came into being. The traditional PLC solution is based on signal analysis[1-2], which can be divided into two types: based on the sender and based on the receiver. The former is to use the encoded redundant information to recover the lost speech signal. However, this method requires extra bandwidth. The latter is to reconstruct the speech signal by using the decoding parameter information before packet loss. The biggest advantage of the traditional PLC method is that the calculation is simple and can be processed online; the disadvantage is that it can only effectively combat packet loss of about 40ms and cannot deal with long-term continuous burst packet loss. Therefore, the processing capability of the traditional PLC algorithms is very limited. In recent years, the research of deep learning in the field of PLC has shown great potential due to the powerful generative capability of deep neural network (DNNs). The existing deep PLC methods are to reconstruct the lost speech signal at the receiver. The first is an offline non-causal processing framework [3-7]. In addition to using historical unmissed frames, it is also possible to use broader contextual information including future frames. These methods are not suitable for online applications. The second is a causal processing framework that uses historical unmissed frames for post-processing. B.K. Lee et al.[8] are pioneers in using autoregressive model to solve the packet loss problem. Since then, deep PLC algorithms based on autoregressive models have been continuously proposed. Such as convolutional recurrent network (CRN) [9-10], long-short term memory network (LSTM)[11-12] and WaveRNN[13]. The common feature of these methods is to use the effective information of previous frames to recursively inference the current frame. However, the context leading up to the frame to be predicted can contain many reconstructed frames instead of original frames, creating a mismatch between training and inference. When long-term continuous burst packet loss occurs, the generated waveform will be greatly attenuated and the of speech quality needs to be further improved. In addition, the phase of the compensated speech signal and the real speech signal is discontinuous. Note: For how to use QwenLong-CPRS-7B, please refer to the github repo QwenLong-CPRS: Towards ∞-LLMs with Dynamic Context Optimization Weizhou Shen, Chenliang Li, Fanqi Wan, Shengyi Liao, Shaopeng Lai, Bo Zhang, Yingcheng Shi, Yuning Wu, Gang Fu, Zhansheng Li, Bin Yang,Ji Zhang, Fei Huang, Jingren Zhou, Ming Yan * Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group 📚 Introduction In this work, we present QwenLong-CPRS, a novel framework designed to optimize long-context processing through query-aware multi-granularity compression, outperforming RAG and sparse attention methods. Distinct from RAG's coarse chunk-level retrieval, it achieves precise information extraction via token-level content selection, enhancing accuracy. Unlike sparse attention (SA) requiring model retraining, it functions as a plug-and-play module compatible with any downstream LLMs while eliminating retraining demands. This dual advantage enables both fine-grained context optimization and seamless integration across architectures. We implement QwenLong-CPRS with four key innovations: Controllable Context Optimization : Processes control prompts + queries to generate compact, task-specific context segments without retraining. Hybrid Attention Architecture : Combines bi-directional modeling (context localization) with causal LM (representation fidelity). LM-as-Critic Framework : Repurposes the pretrained LM head to score token relevance, preserving original knowledge while enabling compression. Window-Parrallel Inference : Splits long context into $w$-sized windows for parallel processing, reducing prefill complexity. 🎉 News May 26, 2025: 🔥 We release 🤗 QwenLong-CPRS-7B , a 7B context compression model designed for explicit long-context optimization. 🔥 Key Achievements : ✅ Superior Performance : Outperforms RAG and sparse attention in both accuracy and efficiency across five long-context benchmarks. ✅ Universal Compatibility : Seamlessly integrates with all flagship LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0-pro, Claude 3.7-sonnet, DeepSeek-v3, Qwen2.5-max), achieving 21.59× context compression and +19.15 avg. performance boost. ✅ New SOTA : When paired with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, it surpasses top proprietary models by +4.85 on Ruler-128K and +10.88 on InfiniteBench, setting a new SOTA. May 24, 2025: 🔥 We release the 💻 Demo Code for deploying the QwenLong-CPRS API and runing simpling long-context tasks with QwenLong-CPRS cascading an LLM. 🛠️ Requirements # Create the conda environment conda create -n qwenlong-cprs python==3.10 conda activate qwenlong-cprs # Install verl cd QwenLong-CPRS pip3 install -e . 🚀 Quick Start Here we provide how to run QwenLong-CPRS with LLM in a long-context task: Step 1: Deploy local QwenLong-CPRS API cd QwenLong-CPRS/src/api_utils export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 export MODEL_DIR= "Tongyi-Zhiwen/QwenLong-CPRS-7B" uvicorn run_api:app --port 8091 --host '0.0.0.0' --workers 1 Step 2: Data Preparation Download Ruler-128K test data from huggingface-hub and put it on the data folder. Step 3: Run the demo inference code cd QwenLong-CPRS/examples export LLM_APIKEY= "" # your llm api key export LLM_APIURL= "" # your llm api url # for NIAH tasks export CPRS_PROMPT= "You are an expert for information extraction, your task is to extract the 'needles' in the format of 'One of the special magic {type_needle_v} for {key} is: {value}.' from the documents to answer user's question.\N## tagging rule:
- tag the needles with 'needle'" python infer.py \ --model "your LLM model name" \ --input_path "data/niah.jsonl" \ --output_path "output/llm_with_cprs/niah.jsonl" \ --cprs_prompt " $CPRS_PROMPT " \ --use_compress True # for qa tasks export CPRS_PROMPT= "You are an expert for information extraction, your task is to extract some sentences from the documents as the supporting facts of the user's question.
## tagging rule:
- tag the supporting facts with 'fact'" python infer.py \ --model "your LLM model name" \ --input_path "data/qa.jsonl" \ --output_path "output/llm_with_cprs/niah.jsonl" \ --cprs_prompt " $CPRS_PROMPT " \ --use_compress True # for variable tracking tasks expor

search_index.title: QwenLong-CPRS: Towards ∞-LLMs with Dynamic Context Optimization
search_index.content: QwenLong-CPRS: Towards ∞-LLMs with Dynamic Context Optimization Skip to main content Title: Content selection saved. Describe the issue below: Description: License: CC BY 4.0 arXiv:2505.18092v2 [cs.CL] 27 May 2025 QwenLong-CPRS : Towards ∞ \infty -LLMs with Dynamic Context Optimization Thanks: Corresponding author Weizhou Shen Chenliang Li Fanqi Wan Shengyi Liao Shaopeng Lai Bo Zhang Affiliation: Yingcheng Shi, Yuning Wu, Gang Fu, Zhansheng Li, Bin Yang, Affiliation: Ji Zhang, Fei Huang, Jingren Zhou, Ming Yan Affiliation: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group Abstract This technical report presents QwenLong-CPRS , a context compression framework designed for explicit long-context optimization, addressing prohibitive computation overhead during the prefill stage and the “lost in the middle” performance degradation of large language models (LLMs) during long sequence processing. Implemented through a novel dynamic context optimization mechanism, QwenLong-CPRS enables multi-granularity context compression guided by natural language instructions, achieving both efficiency gains and improved performance. Evolved from the Qwen architecture series, QwenLong-CPRS introduces four key innovations: (1) Natural language-guided dynamic optimization, (2) Bidirectional reasoning layers for enhanced boundary awareness, (3) Token critic mechanisms with language modeling heads, and (4) Window-parallel inference. Comprehensive evaluations across five benchmarks (4K-2M word contexts) demonstrate QwenLong-CPRS ’s threefold effectiveness: (1) Consistent superiority over other context management methods like RAG and sparse attention in both accuracy and efficiency. (2) Architecture-agnostic integration with all flagship LLMs, including GPT-4o, Gemini2.0-pro, Claude3.7-sonnet, DeepSeek-v3, and Qwen2.5-max, achieves 21.59 × \times context compression alongside 19.15-point average performance gains; (3) Deployed with Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, QwenLong-CPRS surpasses leading proprietary LLMs by 4.85 and 10.88 points on Ruler-128K and InfiniteBench, establishing new SOTA performance. https://github.com/Tongyi-Zhiwen/QwenLong-CPRS https://huggingface.co/Tongyi-Zhiwen/QwenLong-CPRS-7B https://modelscope.cn/models/iic/QwenLong-CPRS-7B (a) The input compression rate and performance gain when different LLMs are cascaded with QwenLong-CPRS . (b) Performance of Qwen2.5-32b-instruct with different context management methods. Figure 1 : Illustration of the performance of QwenLong-CPRS . Figure 1(a) compares the input token consumption and model performance of various LLMs on Ruler-128K before (marked with ◇ \Diamond ) and after (marked with Δ \Delta ) cascading QwenLong-CPRS . Figure 1(b) highlights the performance improvements of QwenLong-CPRS over other context management methods, such as RAG [ 22 ] and sparse attention [ 16 ] . 1 Introduction Enhancing the long-context processing capabilities of large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a critical research frontier in both academia and industry [ 31 , 39 , 34 , 1 ] . Recent advancements in positional embedding techniques [ 38 , 33 ] and the curation of synthetic long-context training data [ 3 ] have enabled significant progress in extending LLMs’ context windows, achieving expansions from 4K to over 1M tokens [ 46 , 10 ] . Despite these advances, two critical challenges persist. First, the quadratic computational complexity of processing long sequences imposes prohibitive efficiency costs. Second, the unresolved “lost in the middle” phenomenon [ 25 ] , where LLMs struggle to effectively prioritize critical information within lengthy inputs. A fundamental strategy involves efficiently managing long context by focusing on key content within the model’s reliable context window [ 26 ] . Building upon this strategy, two primary approaches have been proposed: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks [ 21 , 7 ] enhance computational efficiency by dynamically retrieving query-relevant text chunks from input contexts, enabling selective processing of contextual information. Conversely, sparse attention (SA) mechanisms [ 16 , 27 , 49 ] redesign the self-attention mechanism within LLMs, either by restricting attention computations to structured patterns or by prioritizing critical token interactions during sequential generation. Despite their advantages, both approaches exhibit significant limitations. First, RAG systems, while efficient, rely on coarse-grained chunk-level embeddings, leading to imprecise outputs. This limitation becomes particularly problematic in scenarios requiring fine-grained localization of uniformly distributed knowledge [ 23 ] . On the other hand, SA methods, though flexible in token-level aggregation, necessitate substential data construction and computationally intensive model training to optimize attention patterns [ 27 , 49 ] , alongside specialized infrastructure investments. To address these challenges, we introduce an innovative dynamic context optimization paradigm, which aims to improve context-processing efficiency through maximizing information density. As depicted in Figure 2 , this approach dynamically compresses input contexts into query-tailored segments across different granularities, enabling concise and accurate context optimization for various user queries. This paradigm advances existing methods in two key aspects. First, it replaces RAG’s coarse chunk-level retrieval with precise token-level content selection, enhancing information identification accuracy. Second, it operates independently as a plug-and-play component, eliminating SA’s requirement for model retraining while maintaining compatibility with any downstream LLMs. Figure 2 : The concept of dynamic context optimization , which aims to enhance context processing efficiency by maximizing information density. Given a long-context input, this paradigm dynamically compresses it into query-specific content at varying granularities, facilitating concise and accurate information extraction

</div>

## FuseAI

FuseAI is an open-source research community focused on model fusion topics. 

The community members currently applying model fusion on Foundation, Chat, o1-like LLMs.

Welcome to join us!

## News

### FuseO1-Preview [74.0 on AIME24, approaching OpenAI o1's 79.2]

- **Jan 21, 2025:** 🔥 [FuseO1-Preview](https://huggingface.co/collections/FuseAI/fuseo1-preview-678eb56093649b2688bc9977) is our initial endeavor to enhance the System-II reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through innovative model fusion techniques. By employing our advanced [SCE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.07990) merging methodologies, we integrate multiple open-source o1-like LLMs into a unified model. Our goal is to incorporate the distinct knowledge and strengths from different reasoning LLMs into a single, unified model with strong System-II reasoning abilities, particularly in mathematics, coding, and science domains.

To achieve this, we conduct two types of model merging:

- **Long-Long Reasoning Merging**: This approach involves model fusion across LLMs that utilize long-CoT reasoning, with the goal of enhancing long-CoT reasoning capabilities. The resulted [FuseAI/FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/FuseAI/FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview) achieves a Pass@1 accuracy of **74.0 on AIME24**, demonstrating significant performance improvements compared to the OpenAI o1-preview (44.6) and OpenAI o1-mini (63.4), even approaching OpenAI o1 (79.2).
- **Long-Short Reasoning Merging**: This approach involves model fusion between long-CoT and short-CoT LLMs, aiming to improve reasoning capabilities in both long and short reasoning processes. The resulted [FuseAI/FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-Qwen2.5-Instruct-32B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/FuseAI/FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-Qwen2.5-Instruct-32B-Preview) and [FuseAI/FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/FuseAI/FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Preview) is capable of utilizing both long and short reasoning processes and demonstrates relatively strong performance in long reasoning tasks.

<p align="center">
 <img src="fuseo1-preview.jpg" width="100%"> <br>
</p>


### FuseChat-3.0 [SOTA 8B LLM on AlpacaEval-2 & Arena-Hard]

- **Dec 12, 2024:** 🔥 We release [FuseChat-3.0](https://huggingface.co/collections/FuseAI/fusechat-30-6752d18dec430bad7a236a75) and [Blog Post](https://slit-ai.github.io/FuseChat-3.0/). FuseChat-3.0 contains a series of models crafted to enhance performance by integrating the strengths of multiple source LLMs into more compact target LLMs. To achieve this fusion, we utilized four powerful source LLMs: [Gemma-2-27b-It](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-2-27b-it), [Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407), [Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-72B-Instruct), and [Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct). For the target LLMs, we employed three widely-used smaller models—[Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), [Gemma-2-9B-It](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-2-9b-it), and [Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct)—along with two even more compact models—[Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct) and [Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct). . The implicit model fusion process involves a two-stage training pipeline comprising Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to mitigate distribution discrepancies between target and source LLMs, and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for learning preferences from multiple source LLMs. The resulting FuseChat-3.0 models demonstrated substantial improvements in tasks related to general conversation, instruction following, mathematics, and coding. Notably, when Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct served as the target LLM, our fusion approach achieved an average improvement of **6.8** points across 14 benchmarks. Moreover, it showed significant improvements of **37.1** and **30.1** points on instruction-following test sets AlpacaEval-2 and Arena-Hard respectively. 

<p align="center">
 <img src="FuseChat-3.0.png" width="60%"> <br>
</p>

search_index.description: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
search_index.content: Danh sách kiểm tra phát hành Mô hình · Hugging Face Hub documentation Danh sách kiểm tra phát hành Mô hình Hub 🏡 View all docs AWS Trainium & Inferentia Accelerate Bitsandbytes CLI Chat UI Dataset viewer Datasets Deploying on AWS Diffusers Google Cloud Google TPUs Gradio Hub Hub Python Library Huggingface.js Inference Endpoints (dedicated) Inference Providers Kernels LeRobot Leaderboards Lighteval Microsoft Azure OpenEnv Optimum PEFT Reachy Mini Safetensors Sentence Transformers TRL Tasks Text Embeddings Inference Tokenizers Trackio Transformers Transformers.js Xet smolagents timm Search documentation AR EN ES FR ID JA KO PT RU TR VI ZH API docs Join the Hugging Face community and get access to the augmented documentation experience Collaborate on models, datasets and Spaces Faster examples with accelerated inference Switch between documentation themes Sign Up to get started Copy page Danh sách kiểm tra phát hành Mô hình Hugging Face Hub là nền tảng hàng đầu để chia sẻ các mô hình machine learning. Một bản phát hành được thực hiện tốt có thể tăng khả năng hiển thị và tác động của mô hình của bạn. Phần này bao gồm các bước cần thiết cho một bản phát hành mô hình ngắn gọn, cung cấp thông tin đầy đủ và thân thiện với người dùng. Phát hành với một tác nhân lập trình? Cài đặt hf CLI Skill để tác nhân của bạn tự động xử lý việc tải lên, thẻ mô hình và metadata cho bạn. ⏳ Chuẩn bị Mô hình của Bạn để Phát hành Tải lên trọng số mô hình Khi tải các mô hình lên Hub, hãy tuân thủ các thực hành tốt nhất sau: Sử dụng các kho lưu trữ riêng cho các bộ trọng số mô hình khác nhau : Tạo các kho lưu trữ riêng cho từng biến thể của cùng một kiến trúc. Điều này cho phép bạn nhóm chúng thành một bộ sưu tập , dễ điều hướng hơn so với danh sách thư mục. Nó cũng cải thiện khả năng hiển thị vì mỗi mô hình có URL riêng ( hf.co/org/model-name ), giúp tìm kiếm dễ dàng hơn và cung cấp số lượt tải xuống cho từng mô hình của bạn. Một ví dụ tuyệt vời là bộ sưu tập Qwen3-VL gần đây, bao gồm các biến thể khác nhau của kiến trúc VL. Ưu tiên safetensors hơn pickle để serialize trọng số. : safetensors an toàn và nhanh hơn pickle hoặc pth của Python. Nếu bạn có tệp pickle .bin , hãy dùng công cụ chuyển đổi trọng số để chuyển đổi. Viết Thẻ Mô Hình Chi Tiết Một thẻ mô tả model được viết kỹ lưỡng (tức là README.md trong kho của bạn) là yếu tố thiết yếu để tăng khả năng tìm thấy, tái lập và chia sẻ hiệu quả. Hãy đảm bảo bao gồm các nội dung sau: Cấu hình Metadata : Phần metadata (YAML) ở đầu thẻ mô hình của bạn đóng vai trò then chốt cho việc tìm kiếm và phân loại. Bao gồm: Đã sao chép --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Nếu bạn tạo README.md trong Web UI, bạn sẽ thấy một biểu mẫu chứa các trường metadata quan trọng nhất mà chúng tôi khuyến nghị 🤗. Biểu mẫu Metadata trên giao diện Hub Mô tả chi tiết về Mô hình : Cung cấp giải thích rõ ràng về những gì mô hình của bạn thực hiện, kiến trúc của nó và các trường hợp sử dụng dự kiến. Giúp người dùng nhanh chóng quyết định xem nó có phù hợp với nhu cầu của họ hay không. Ví dụ sử dụng : Cung cấp các đoạn mã rõ ràng, có thể sao chép và chạy ngay cho suy luận, tinh chỉnh hoặc các tác vụ phổ biến khác. Giữ cho các chỉnh sửa cần thiết từ phía người dùng ở mức tối thiểu. Phần thưởng : Thêm một notebook.ipynb được cấu trúc tốt trong repo, minh họa việc suy luận hoặc tinh chỉnh, để người dùng có thể mở trực tiếp trong Google Colab và Kaggle Notebooks . Nút sử dụng Google và Kaggle Thông số kỹ thuật : Bao gồm các tham số huấn luyện, yêu cầu phần cứng và các chi tiết khác giúp người dùng chạy mô hình một cách hiệu quả. Chỉ số hiệu năng : Chia sẻ các kết quả chuẩn (benchmark) và đánh giá. Bao gồm các chỉ số định lượng và ví dụ định tính để thể hiện điểm mạnh và hạn chế. Hạn chế và Thiên kiến : Tài liệu hóa các hạn chế, thiên kiến và các cân nhắc đạo đức đã biết để người dùng có thể đưa ra lựa chọn sáng suốt. Để quá trình diễn ra liền mạch hơn, hãy nhấp vào Import model card template để tự động điền các README.md với các giá trị thay thế. Nút để nhập mẫu thẻ mô hình Một phần của mẫu được nhập Nâng cao khả năng tìm kiếm và sử dụng mô hình Để tối đa hóa phạm vi tiếp cận và khả năng sử dụng: Tích hợp thư viện : Thêm hỗ trợ cho một trong nhiều thư viện được tích hợp với Hugging Face Hub (chẳng hạn như transformers , diffusers , sentence-transformers , timm ). Việc tích hợp này tăng đáng kể khả năng tiếp cận mô hình của bạn và cung cấp cho người dùng các đoạn mã để làm việc với mô hình của bạn. Ví dụ, để chỉ định rằng mô hình của bạn hoạt động với thư viện transformers : Đã sao chép --- library_name: transformers --- Tab đoạn mã Bạn cũng có thể đăng ký thư viện mô hình của riêng mình hoặc thêm hỗ trợ Hub vào thư viện và mã nguồn của bạn, để người dùng biết cách tải trọng số mô hình từ Hub. Chúng tôi đã viết một hướng dẫn chi tiết về các thực hành tốt nhất khi tải lên tại đây . Việc sử dụng một thư viện đã đăng ký cũng cho phép bạn theo dõi số lượt tải xuống mô hình của mình theo thời gian. Metadata chính xác : Thẻ Pipeline: Chọn thẻ pipeline chính xác để mô hình của bạn xuất hiện trong các tìm kiếm và widget phù hợp. Các ví dụ về thẻ pipeline phổ biến: text-generation - Dành cho các mô hình ngôn ngữ tạo văn bản text-to-image - Dành cho các mô hình tạo ảnh từ văn bản image-text-to-text - Dành cho các mô hình thị giác-ngôn ngữ (VLM) tạo ra văn bản text-to-speech - Dành cho các mô hình tạo âm thanh từ văn bản Giấy phép: Thông tin giấy phép rất quan trọng để người dùng hiểu cách họ có thể sử dụng mô hình. Bài báo nghiên cứu : Nếu mô hình của bạn có các bài báo liên quan, hãy trích

İyi planlanmış bir sürüm, modelinizin görünürlüğünü ve etkisini artırabilir. Bu bölüm, kısa, bilgilendirici ve kullanıcı dostu bir model sürümü için temel adımları ele alır. Kodlama ajanıyla mı yayınlıyorsunuz? Ajanınızın yükleme, model kartı ve meta verileri sizin yerinize halletmesi için hf CLI Skill kurun. ⏳ Modelinizi Yayına Hazırlama Model Ağırlıklarını Yükle Hub'a modeller yüklerken şu en iyi uygulamaları izleyin: Farklı model ağırlıkları için ayrı depolar kullanın : Aynı mimarinin her varyantı için ayrı depolar oluşturun. Bu, onları gezinmesi dizin listelerinden daha kolay olan bir koleksiyon içinde gruplamanızı sağlar. Ayrıca her modelin kendi URL'sine ( hf.co/org/model-name ) sahip olması görünürlüğü artırır, aramayı kolaylaştırır ve modellerinizin her biri için indirme sayıları sağlar. Bunun harika bir örneği, VL mimarisinin çeşitli varyantlarını içeren son Qwen3-VL koleksiyonu 'dur. Ağırlık seri hale getirme için safetensors 'i pickle yerine tercih edin. : safetensors , Python'un pickle veya pth formatlarından daha güvenli ve hızlıdır. Bir .bin pickle dosyanız varsa, dönüştürmek için ağırlık dönüştürme aracını kullanın. Kapsamlı Bir Model Kartı Yazın İyi hazırlanmış bir model kartı (deponuzdaki README.md ) keşfedilebilirlik, yeniden üretilebilirlik ve etkili paylaşım için hayati öneme sahiptir. Şu konuları kapsadığınızdan emin olun: Meta Veri Yapılandırması : Model kartınızın üst kısmındaki metadata bölümü (YAML), arama ve sınıflandırma için kritiktir. Şunları ekleyin: Kopyalandı --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Web arayüzünde README.md dosyasını oluşturursanız, önerdiğimiz en önemli meta veri alanlarını içeren bir form görürsünüz 🤗. Hub Arayüzündeki Meta Veri Formu Ayrıntılı Model Açıklaması : Modelinizin ne yaptığını, mimarisini ve hedef kullanım senaryolarını açıkça anlatın. Kullanıcıların modelin ihtiyaçlarına uygun olup olmadığını hızla değerlendirmesine yardımcı olun. Kullanım Örnekleri : Çıkarım, ince ayar veya diğer yaygın görevler için net, kopyala-çalıştır kod parçacıkları sağlayın. Kullanıcıların yapması gereken düzenlemeleri en aza indirin. Bonus : Kullanıcıların doğrudan Google Colab ve Kaggle Notebooks içinde açabilmesi için, çıkarım veya ince ayar gösteren iyi yapılandırılmış bir notebook.ipynb dosyasını depoya ekleyin. Google ve Kaggle Kullanım Düğmeleri Teknik Özellikler : Modeli etkili bir şekilde çalıştırmaya yardımcı olan eğitim parametreleri, donanım gereksinimleri ve diğer ayrıntıları ekleyin. Performans Metrikleri : Çalışma ölçümleri ve değerlendirme sonuçlarını paylaşın. Güçlü yönleri ve sınırlamaları göstermek için nicel metrikler ve nitel örnekler ekleyin. Kısıtlamalar ve Yanlılıklar : Kullanıcıların bilinçli seçimler yapabilmesi için bilinen kısıtlamaları, yanlılıkları ve etik hususları belgeleyin. Süreci daha akıcı hale getirmek için README.md dosyalarını yer tutucularla önceden doldurmak üzere Model kartı şablonunu içe aktar seçeneğine tıklayın. Model kartı şablonunu içe aktarmak için düğme İçe aktarılan şablonun bir bölümü Model Keşfedilebilirliğini ve Kullanılabilirliğini Geliştirin Erişimi ve kullanılabilirliği en üst düzeye çıkarmak için: Kütüphane Entegrasyonu : Hugging Face Hub ile entegre edilen birçok kütüphaneden ( transformers , diffusers , sentence-transformers , timm gibi) birine destek ekleyin. Bu entegrasyon, modelinizin erişilebilirliğini önemli ölçüde artırır ve kullanıcılara modelinizle çalışma için kod parçacıkları sağlar. Örneğin, modelinizin transformers kütüphanesiyle çalıştığını belirtmek için: Kopyalandı --- library_name: transformers --- Kod parçası sekmesi Ayrıca kendi model kitaplığınızı kaydedebilir veya kitaplığınıza ve kod tabanınıza Hub desteği ekleyerek kullanıcıların Hub'dan model ağırlıklarını nasıl indireceklerini bilmelerini sağlayabilirsiniz. Yükleme en iyi uygulamaları hakkında kapsamlı bir rehber burada yazdık. Kayıtlı bir kitaplık kullanmak, modelinizin indirme sayısını zaman içinde izlemenize de olanak tanır. Doğru Meta Veri : Pipeline Etiketi: Modelinizin doğru aramalarda ve widget'lerde görünmesi için doğru pipeline etiketini seçin. Yaygın pipeline etiketlerinin örnekleri: text-generation - Metin üreten dil modelleri için text-to-image - Metinden görüntüye üretim modelleri için image-text-to-text - Metin üreten görme-dil modelleri (VLM) için text-to-speech - Metinden ses üreten modeller için Lisans: Lisans bilgisi, modelin nasıl kullanılacağını anlamaları açısından kullanıcılar için hayati önem taşır. Araştırma Makaleleri : Modelinizle ilişkili makaleler varsa, bunları model kartında alın

search_index.title: Daftar Periksa Rilis Model · Hugging Face
search_index.description: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
search_index.content: Daftar Periksa Rilis Model · Hugging Face Hub documentation Daftar Periksa Rilis Model Hub 🏡 View all docs AWS Trainium & Inferentia Accelerate Bitsandbytes CLI Chat UI Dataset viewer Datasets Deploying on AWS Diffusers Google Cloud Google TPUs Gradio Hub Hub Python Library Huggingface.js Inference Endpoints (dedicated) Inference Providers Kernels LeRobot Leaderboards Lighteval Microsoft Azure OpenEnv Optimum PEFT Reachy Mini Safetensors Sentence Transformers TRL Tasks Text Embeddings Inference Tokenizers Trackio Transformers Transformers.js Xet smolagents timm Search documentation AR EN ES FR ID JA KO PT RU TR VI ZH API docs Join the Hugging Face community and get access to the augmented documentation experience Collaborate on models, datasets and Spaces Faster examples with accelerated inference Switch between documentation themes Sign Up to get started Copy page Daftar Periksa Rilis Model Hugging Face Hub adalah platform utama untuk berbagi model machine learning. Rilis yang dieksekusi dengan baik dapat meningkatkan visibilitas dan dampak model Anda. Bagian ini membahas langkah-langkah esensial untuk rilis model yang ringkas, informatif, dan ramah pengguna. Menerbitkan dengan agen pemrograman? Instal hf CLI Skill agar agen Anda dapat menangani unggahan, kartu model, dan metadata untuk Anda. ⏳ Menyiapkan Model Anda untuk Rilis Unggah Bobot Model Saat mengunggah model ke Hub, ikuti praktik terbaik berikut: Gunakan repositori terpisah untuk bobot model yang berbeda : Buat repositori individual untuk setiap varian dari arsitektur yang sama. Hal ini memungkinkan Anda mengelompokkannya ke dalam koleksi , yang lebih mudah dinavigasi daripada daftar direktori. Hal ini juga meningkatkan visibilitas karena setiap model memiliki URL-nya sendiri ( hf.co/org/model-name ), memudahkan pencarian, dan menyediakan jumlah unduhan untuk masing-masing model Anda. Contoh yang bagus adalah koleksi Qwen3-VL baru-baru ini yang menampilkan berbagai varian arsitektur VL. Gunakan safetensors alih-alih pickle untuk serialisasi bobot. : safetensors lebih aman dan cepat daripada pickle atau pth Python. Jika Anda memiliki file pickle .bin , gunakan alat konversi bobot untuk mengonversinya. Menulis Kartu Model yang Komprehensif Kartu model yang dibuat dengan baik ( README.md di repositori Anda) sangat penting untuk kemudahan penemuan, reproduktibilitas, dan berbagi yang efektif. Pastikan untuk mencakup: Konfigurasi Metadata : Bagian metadata (YAML) di bagian atas model card Anda sangat penting untuk pencarian dan kategorisasi. Sertakan: Disalin --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Jika Anda membuat README.md di Web UI, Anda akan melihat formulir dengan bidang metadata terpenting yang kami rekomendasikan 🤗. Form Metadata di UI Hub Deskripsi Model Rinci : Berikan penjelasan yang jelas tentang apa yang dilakukan model Anda, arsitekturnya, dan kasus penggunaan yang dimaksudkan. Bantu pengguna dengan cepat memutuskan apakah model tersebut sesuai dengan kebutuhan mereka. Contoh Penggunaan : Sediakan potongan kode yang jelas dan siap salin-jalankan untuk inferensi, penyesuaian halus, atau tugas umum lainnya. Minimalkan perubahan yang perlu dilakukan pengguna. Bonus : Tambahkan notebook.ipynb yang terstruktur dengan baik di repo untuk menunjukkan inferensi atau fine-tuning, sehingga pengguna dapat membukanya langsung di Google Colab dan Kaggle Notebooks . Tombol Penggunaan Google dan Kaggle Spesifikasi Teknis : Sertakan parameter pelatihan, kebutuhan perangkat keras, dan detail lain yang membantu pengguna menjalankan model secara efektif. Metriks Kinerja : Bagikan hasil benchmark dan evaluasi. Sertakan metrik kuantitatif dan contoh kualitatif untuk menunjukkan kekuatan dan keterbatasannya. Batasan dan Bias : Dokumentasikan batasan, bias, dan pertimbangan etika yang diketahui agar pengguna dapat membuat pilihan yang tepat. Untuk membuat prosesnya lebih mulus, klik Import model card template untuk mengisi README.md dengan placeholder. Tombol untuk mengimpor templat kartu model Bagian dari template yang diimpor Meningkatkan Kemudahan Penemuan dan Penggunaan Model Untuk memaksimalkan jangkauan dan kegunaan: Integrasi Library : Tambahkan dukungan untuk salah satu dari banyak library yang terintegrasi dengan Hugging Face Hub (seperti transformers , diffusers , sentence-transformers , timm ). Integrasi ini secara signifikan meningkatkan aksesibilitas model Anda dan menyediakan pengguna dengan potongan kode untuk bekerja dengan model Anda. Sebagai contoh, untuk menentukan bahwa model Anda bekerja dengan pustaka transformers : Disalin --- library_name: transformers --- Tab cuplikan kode Anda juga dapat mendaftarkan pustaka model Anda sendiri atau menambahkan dukungan Hub ke pustaka dan basis kode Anda, sehingga pengguna mengetahui cara mengunduh bobot model dari Hub. Kami menulis panduan ekstensif tentang praktik terbaik pengunggahan di sini . Menggunakan pustaka yang terdaftar juga memungkinkan Anda untuk melacak unduhan model Anda dari waktu ke waktu. Metadata yang Benar : Tag Pipeline: Pilih pipeline tag yang tepat agar model Anda muncul di pencarian dan widget yang benar. Contoh tag pipeline yang umum: text-generation - Untuk model bahasa yang menghasilkan teks text-to-image - Untuk model generasi teks-ke-gambar image-text-to-text - Untuk model bahasa-visi (VLM) yang menghasilkan teks text-to-speech - Untuk model yang menghasilkan audio dari teks Lisensi: Informasi lisensi sangat penting agar pengguna memahami cara penggunaan model. Makalah Penelitian : Jika model Anda memiliki makalah terkait, kutipkan

search_index.content: モデルリリースチェックリスト · Hugging Face Hub documentation モデルリリースチェックリスト Hub 🏡 View all docs AWS Trainium & Inferentia Accelerate Bitsandbytes CLI Chat UI Dataset viewer Datasets Deploying on AWS Diffusers Google Cloud Google TPUs Gradio Hub Hub Python Library Huggingface.js Inference Endpoints (dedicated) Inference Providers Kernels LeRobot Leaderboards Lighteval Microsoft Azure OpenEnv Optimum PEFT Reachy Mini Safetensors Sentence Transformers TRL Tasks Text Embeddings Inference Tokenizers Trackio Transformers Transformers.js Xet smolagents timm Search documentation AR EN ES FR ID JA KO PT RU TR VI ZH API docs Join the Hugging Face community and get access to the augmented documentation experience Collaborate on models, datasets and Spaces Faster examples with accelerated inference Switch between documentation themes Sign Up to get started Copy page モデルリリースチェックリスト Hugging Face Hub は、機械学習モデルの共有のための定番プラットフォームです。 適切に行われたリリースは、モデルの認知度とインパクトを高めることができます。このセクションでは、簡潔で情報量があり、ユーザーフレンドリーなモデルリリースのための 必須 の手順について説明します。 コーディングエージェントでリリースしますか？ hf CLI Skill をインストールして、アップロード、モデルカード、メタデータの処理をエージェントに代行させましょう。 ⏳ モデルの公開に向けた準備 モデルの重みをアップロードする Hubにモデルをアップロードする際は、以下のベストプラクティスに従ってください。 異なるモデルの重みには別々のリポジトリを使用する : 同じアーキテクチャの各バリアントに対して個別のリポジトリを作成します。これにより、 コレクション としてグループ化でき、ディレクトリ一覧よりもナビゲーションが容易になります。また、各モデルに固有のURL（ hf.co/org/model-name ）が割り当てられるため、視認性が向上し、検索が容易になり、各モデルのダウンロード数が提供されます。優れた例として、VLアーキテクチャのさまざまなバリアントを収録した最近の Qwen3-VLコレクション があります。 safetensors を pickle より優先して重みのシリアライズに使用してください。 : safetensors はPythonの pickle や pth よりも安全で高速です。 .bin のpickleファイルがある場合は、 重み変換ツール を使用して変換してください。 包括的なモデルカードの作成 適切に作成されたモデルカード（リポジトリ内の README.md ）は、発見可能性、再現性、効果的な共有のために不可欠です。以下の点について記載してください。 メタデータ設定 : モデルカードの上部にある メタデータセクション (YAML)は、検索と分類において重要です。以下を含めてください: コピーしました --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Web UI で README.md を作成すると、推奨する最も重要なメタデータフィールドを含むフォームが表示されます 🤗。 Hub UIのメタデータフォーム モデルの詳細な説明 : モデルの機能、アーキテクチャ、想定されるユースケースについて明確に説明してください。ユーザーが自分のニーズに合致するかを素早く判断できるように支援します。 使用例 : 推論、ファインチューニング、その他の一般的なタスクに対して、明確でそのままコピーして実行できるコードスニペットを提供します。ユーザーが加える必要がある編集は最小限に抑えてください。 ボーナス : 推論またはファインチューニングを示す、構成の整った notebook.ipynb をリポジトリに追加し、ユーザーが Google ColabやKaggle Notebooks で直接開けるようにします。 Google と Kaggle の使用ボタン 技術仕様 : モデルを効果的に実行するために役立つ、学習パラメータ、ハードウェア要件、その他の詳細を含めてください。 パフォーマンス指標 : ベンチマークおよび評価結果を共有してください。強みと限界を示すために、定量的な指標と定性的な例を含めてください。 制約とバイアス : ユーザーが情報に基づいた選択を行えるよう、既知の制約、バイアス、倫理的な考慮事項を文書化してください。 プロセスをよりシームレスにするために、 Import model card template をクリックして、プレースホルダー付きの README.md を事前入力してください。 モデルカードテンプレートをインポートするためのボタン インポートされたテンプレートのセクション モデルの発見性と使いやす性の向上 リーチと使いやすさを最大化するために: ライブラリ統合 : Hugging Face Hub と統合されている多くのライブラリ （ transformers 、 diffusers 、 sentence-transformers 、 timm など）のいずれかに対するサポートを追加します。この統合により、モデルのアクセシビリティが大幅に向上し、ユーザーにはモデルを扱うためのコードスニペットが提供されます。 例えば、モデルが transformers ライブラリで動作することを指定するには: コピーしました --- library_name: transformers --- コードスニペットタブ また、 独自のモデルライブラリを登録 したり、ライブラリやコードベースに Hub のサポートを追加したりすることで、ユーザーが Hub からモデルの重みをダウンロードする方法を知ることができます。 アップロードのベストプラクティスに関する詳細なガイドを こちら に作成しました。 登録済みライブラリを使用することで、モデルのダウンロード数を時間経過とともに追跡することもできます。 メタデータの修正 : パイプラインタグ: モデルが適切な検索結果やウィジェットに表示されるよう、正しい パイプラインタグ を選択してください。 一般的なパイプラインタグの例: text-generation - テキストを生成する言語モデル向け text-to-image - テキストから画像を生成するモデル向け image-text-to-text - テキストを生成するビジョン・言語モデル（VLM）向け text-to-speech - テキストからオーディオを生成するモデル向け ライセンス: ライセンス情報は、モデルの利用方法を理解するためにユーザーにとって重要です。 研究論文 : モデルに関連する論文がある場合は、モデルカードに引用してください。それらは自動的に 相互リンク されます。 コピーしました ## References * [ Model Paper ]( https://huggingface.co/papers/xxxx.xxxxx ) コレクション : 関連する複数のモデルやバリアントをリリースする場合は、 コレクション にまとめて整理してください。コレクションを使用すると、ユーザーは関連するモデルを見つけやすく、バージョン間の関係性を理解しやすくなります。 デモ : インタラクティブなデモを含む Hugging Face Space を作成します。これにより、ユーザーはコードを書かずにモデルを試すことができます。また、Spaceから モデルへのリンク を設定することで、モデルページのUIに表示させることもできます。 コピーしました ## Demo Try this model directly in your browser: [ Space Demo ]( https://huggingface.co/spaces/username/model-demo ) デモを作成する際は、モデルを外部ソース（Google Drive など）ではなく、その Hub リポジトリからダウンロードしてください。これにより成果物が相互にリンクされ、視認性が向上します。 量子化バージョン : 計算リソースが限られているユーザーのアクセシビリティを向上させるため、量子化バージョン（GGUF など）を別のリポジトリにアップロードすることを検討してください。量子化モデルカード上で、 base_model メタデータフィールド を使用してこれらのバージョンをリンクし、パフォーマンスの違いを文書化してください。 コピーしました --- base_model: username/original-model base_model_relation: quantized --- 量子化バージョンを示すモデルツリー モデルページへのデータセットのリンク : メタデータにデータセットをリンクすることで、モデルページに直接表示されるようになります。 コピーしました --- datasets: - username/dataset - username/dataset-2 --- 新しいモデルのバージョン : モデルが既存のモデルの更新版である場合は、古いモデルのカードにその旨を指定してください。これにより、古いページに更新先へのリンクを含む バナーが表示されます 。 コピーしました --- new_version: username/updated-model --- ビジュアルの例 : 画像や動画の生成モデルでは、 <Gallery> カードコンポーネント を使用して、モデルのページに直接例を含めてください。 コピーしました < Gallery > ![ Example 1 ]( ./images/example1.png ) ![ Example 2 ]( ./images/example2.png ) </ Gallery > 炭素排出量 : 可能であれば、学習に伴う 炭素排出量 を指定してください。 コピーしました --- co2_eq_emissions: emissions: 123.45 source: "CodeCarbon" training_type: "pre-training" geographical_location: "US-East" hardware_used: "8xA100 GPUs" --- アクセス制御と可視性 表示設定 : モデルを共有する準備ができた時点で、 モデル設定 で公開に切り替えてください。その前に、すべてのドキュメントとコード例が正確かつ完全であることを再確認してください。 ゲート付きアクセス : モデルにアクセス制御が必要な場合は、 ゲート付きアクセス機能 を使用し、ユーザーが満たすべき条件を明確に示してください。これは、二重利用の懸念があるモデルや、商用制限があるモデルにとって重要です。 🏁 モデルのリリース後 モデルの公開が成功するには、最初のリリース以降の継続的な取り組みが不可欠です。品質を維持し、インパクトを最大化するために: メンテナンスとコミュニティへの関与 機能の検証 : リリース後、クリーンな環境ですべてのコードスニペットをテストし、期待通りに動作することを確認します。これにより、ユーザーがエラーや混乱なくモデルを実行できることを保証します。 例えば、モデルが transformers 互換のLLMである場合: コピーしました from transformers import pipeline # This should run without errors pipe = pipeline( "text-generation" , model= "your-username/your-model" ) result = pipe( "Your test prompt" ) print (result) 共有 共有 共有 : ほとんどのユーザーは、ソーシャルメディア、チャットチャンネル（Slack や Discor

search_index.content: 모델 릴리스 체크리스트 · Hugging Face Hub documentation 모델 릴리스 체크리스트 Hub 🏡 View all docs AWS Trainium & Inferentia Accelerate Bitsandbytes CLI Chat UI Dataset viewer Datasets Deploying on AWS Diffusers Google Cloud Google TPUs Gradio Hub Hub Python Library Huggingface.js Inference Endpoints (dedicated) Inference Providers Kernels LeRobot Leaderboards Lighteval Microsoft Azure OpenEnv Optimum PEFT Reachy Mini Safetensors Sentence Transformers TRL Tasks Text Embeddings Inference Tokenizers Trackio Transformers Transformers.js Xet smolagents timm Search documentation AR EN ES FR ID JA KO PT RU TR VI ZH API docs Join the Hugging Face community and get access to the augmented documentation experience Collaborate on models, datasets and Spaces Faster examples with accelerated inference Switch between documentation themes Sign Up to get started Copy page 모델 릴리스 체크리스트 Hugging Face Hub 는 머신러닝 모델을 공유하는 데 가장 많이 사용되는 플랫폼입니다. 잘 수행된 릴리스는 모델의 가시성과 영향력을 높일 수 있습니다. 이 섹션에서는 간결하고 정보량이 풍부하며 사용자 친화적인 모델 릴리스를 위한 필수 단계를 다룹니다. 코딩 에이전트로 릴리스를 진행하시나요? hf CLI Skill 을 설치하여 에이전트가 업로드, 모델 카드, 메타데이터를 대신 처리하도록 하세요. ⏳ 모델 릴리스 준비 모델 가중치 업로드 Hub에 모델을 업로드할 때 다음 모범 사례를 따르세요: 다른 모델 가중치를 위한 개별 저장소 사용 : 동일한 아키텍처의 각 변형에 대해 개별 저장소를 생성하세요. 이렇게 하면 컬렉션 으로 묶을 수 있으며, 디렉터리 목록보다 탐색하기가 더 쉽습니다. 또한 각 모델이 고유한 URL( hf.co/org/model-name )을 가지므로 가시성이 향상되고, 검색이 용이해지며, 각 모델에 대한 다운로드 횟수를 제공합니다. 최근 VL 아키텍처의 다양한 변형을 소개하는 Qwen3-VL 컬렉션 이 좋은 예시입니다. safetensors 를 pickle 보다 가중치 직렬화에 우선 사용하세요. : safetensors 는 Python의 pickle 또는 pth 보다 안전하고 빠릅니다. .bin pickle 파일이 있는 경우 가중치 변환 도구 를 사용하여 변환하세요. 포괄적인 모델 카드 작성 잘 작성된 모델 카드(리포지토리의 README.md )는 검색 가능성, 재현성, 효과적인 공유에 필수적입니다. 다음 항목을 반드시 포함하세요: 메타데이터 구성 : 모델 카드 상단의 metadata 섹션 (YAML)은 검색 및 분류에 핵심적입니다. 다음을 포함하세요: 복사됨 --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Web UI에서 README.md 를 생성하면, 권장하는 가장 중요한 메타데이터 필드가 포함된 양식을 볼 수 있습니다 🤗. Hub UI의 메타데이터 양식 모델 상세 설명 : 모델의 기능, 아키텍처, 의도된 사용 사례에 대해 명확하게 설명하세요. 사용자가 자신의 필요에 맞는지 빠르게 판단할 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 사용 예시 : 추론, 파인튜닝 또는 기타 일반적인 작업을 위한 명확하고 바로 복사하여 실행할 수 있는 코드 스니펫을 제공합니다. 사용자가 직접 수정해야 하는 부분을 최소화합니다. 보너스 : 추론 또는 파인튜닝을 보여주는 잘 구조화된 notebook.ipynb 를 저장소에 추가하여 사용자가 Google Colab과 Kaggle Notebooks 에서 바로 열 수 있도록 합니다. Google 및 Kaggle 사용 버튼 기술 사양 : 모델을 효과적으로 실행하는 데 도움이 되는 학습 매개변수, 하드웨어 요구 사항 및 기타 세부 정보를 포함합니다. 성능 지표 : 벤치마크 및 평가 결과를 공유합니다. 강점과 한계를 보여주기 위해 정량적 지표와 정성적 예시를 포함합니다. 한계 및 편향 : 사용자가 정보에 기반한 선택을 할 수 있도록 알려진 한계, 편향 및 윤리적 고려 사항을 문서화합니다. 프로세스를 더 원활하게 만들기 위해 Import model card template 을 클릭하여 README.md 에 플레이스홀더를 미리 채워 넣으세요. 모델 카드 템플릿을 가져오기 위한 버튼 가져온 템플릿의 섹션 모델 검색 가능성 및 사용성 향상 도달 범위와 사용성을 극대화하려면: 라이브러리 통합 : Hugging Face Hub에 통합된 수많은 라이브러리 중 하나(예: transformers , diffusers , sentence-transformers , timm )에 대한 지원을 추가합니다. 이 통합은 모델의 접근성을 크게 높이고, 사용자에게 모델을 다루는 데 사용할 수 있는 코드 스니펫을 제공합니다. 예를 들어, 모델이 transformers 라이브러리와 함께 작동한다고 지정하려면: 복사됨 --- library_name: transformers --- 코드 스니펫 탭 자체 모델 라이브러리를 등록 하거나 라이브러리와 코드베이스에 Hub 지원을 추가하여 사용자가 Hub에서 모델 가중치를 다운로드하는 방법을 알 수 있도록 할 수도 있습니다. 업로드 모범 사례에 대한 상세한 가이드를 여기 에 작성했습니다. 등록된 라이브러리를 사용하면 모델 다운로드 횟수를 시간에 따라 추적할 수도 있습니다. 메타데이터 수정 : 파이프라인 태그: 모델이 올바른 검색 결과와 위젯에 표시되도록 올바른 파이프라인 태그 를 선택하세요. 일반적인 pipeline 태그의 예시: text-generation - 텍스트를 생성하는 언어 모델용 text-to-image - 텍스트-이미지 생성 모델용 image-text-to-text - 텍스트를 생성하는 비전-언어 모델(VLM)에 사용 text-to-speech - 텍스트에서 오디오를 생성하는 모델 라이선스: 라이선스 정보는 사용자가 모델을 어떻게 사용할 수 있는지 이해하는 데 중요합니다. 연구 논문 : 모델에 관련 논문이 있는 경우 모델 카드에 인용하세요. 자동으로 상호 링크 됩니다. 복사됨 ## References * [ Model Paper ]( https://huggingface.co/papers/xxxx.xxxxx ) 컬렉션 : 여러 개의 관련 모델이나 변형을 출시하는 경우, 이를 컬렉션 으로 구성하세요. 컬렉션은 사용자가 관련 모델을 발견하고 버전 간 관계를 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 데모 : 인터랙티브 데모가 포함된 Hugging Face Space 를 만듭니다. 이를 통해 사용자가 코드를 작성하지 않고도 모델을 사용해 볼 수 있습니다. 또한 Space에서 모델을 링크 하여 모델 페이지 UI에 표시되도록 할 수도 있습니다. 복사됨 ## Demo Try this model directly in your browser: [ Space Demo ]( https://huggingface.co/spaces/username/model-demo ) 데모를 생성할 때, 외부 소스(예: Google Drive)가 아닌 Hub 저장소에서 모델을 다운로드합니다. 이를 통해 아티팩트 간 상호 링크가 형성되고 가시성이 향상됩니다. 양자화 버전 : 계산 자원이 제한된 사용자의 접근성을 높이기 위해 양자화 버전(예: GGUF)을 별도의 저장소에 업로드하는 것을 고려해 보세요. 양자화 모델 카드에서 base_model 메타데이터 필드 를 사용해 해당 버전을 링크하고, 성능 차이를 문서화하세요. 복사됨 --- base_model: username/original-model base_model_relation: quantized --- 양자화 버전이 표시된 모델 트리 모델 페이지에 데이터셋 연결 : 메타데이터에 데이터셋을 연결하면 모델 페이지에 바로 표시됩니다. 복사됨 --- datasets: - username/dataset - username/dataset-2 --- 새로운 모델 버전 : 모델이 기존 모델의 업데이트라면, 이전 모델 카드에 이를 명시하세요. 그러면 이전 페이지에 업데이트로 연결되는 배너가 표시 됩니다. 복사됨 --- new_version: username/updated-model --- 시각적 예시 : 이미지 또는 비디오 생성 모델의 경우, <Gallery> 카드 컴포넌트 를 사용하여 모델 페이지에 예시를 직접 포함하세요. 복사됨 < Gallery > ![ Example 1 ]( ./images/example1.png ) ![ Example 2 ]( ./images/example2.png ) </ Gallery > 탄소 배출량 : 가능하다면, 학습에서 발생하는 탄소 배출량 을 명시하세요. 복사됨 --- co2_eq_emissions: emissions: 123.45 source: "CodeCarbon" training_type: "pre-training" geographical_location: "US-East" hardware_used: "8xA100 GPUs" --- 액세스 제어 및 가시성 가시성 설정 : 모델을 공유할 준비가 되면 모델 설정 에서 공개로 전환하세요. 전환하기 전에 모든 문서와 코드 예제가 정확하고 완전한지 다시 확인하세요. 게이트된 액세스 : 모델에 대한 액세스를 제어해야 하는 경우 게이트된 액세스 기능 을 사용하고 사용자가 충족해야 하는 조건을 명확히 명시하세요. 이는 이중 용도 우려나 상업적 제한이 있는 모델의 경우 중요합니다. 🏁 모델 릴리스 후 성공적인 모델 릴리스는 초기 공개 이후에도 계속됩니다. 품질을 유지하고 영향을 극대화하려면: 유지 관리 및 커뮤니티 참여 기능 검증 : 릴리스 후, 모든 코드 스니펫을 깨끗한 환경에서 테스트하여 예상대로 작동하는지 확인합니다. 이를 통해 사용자가 오류나 혼란 없이 모델을 실행할 수 있도록 보장합니다. 예를 들어, 모델이 transformers 와 호환되는 LLM인 경우: 복사됨 from transformers import pipeline # This should run without errors pipe = pipeline( "text-generation" , model= "your-username/your-model" ) result = pipe( "Your test prompt" ) print (result) 공유하기 공유하기 공유하기 : 대부분의 사용자는 소셜 미디어, 채팅 채널(Slack 또는 Discord 등), 뉴스레터를 통해 모델을 발견합니다. 이러한 공간에 모델 링크를 공유하고, 웹사이트나 GitHub 저장소에도 추가하세요. 모델에 대한 방문 및 좋아요가 많을수록 Hugging Face Trending 섹

Una publicación bien ejecutada puede aumentar la visibilidad y el impacto de tu modelo. Esta sección cubre los pasos esenciales para una publicación de modelo concisa, informativa y fácil de usar. ¿Publicando con un agente de código? Instala la hf CLI Skill para que tu agente gestione la carga, la tarjeta del modelo y los metadatos por ti. ⏳ Preparando tu modelo para su lanzamiento Subir los pesos del modelo Al subir modelos al Hub, siga estas mejores prácticas: Usa repositorios separados para diferentes pesos de modelos : Crea repositorios individuales para cada variante de la misma arquitectura. Esto te permite agruparlos en una colección , que es más fácil de navegar que las listas de directorios. También mejora la visibilidad porque cada modelo tiene su propia URL ( hf.co/org/model-name ), facilita la búsqueda y proporciona recuentos de descargas para cada uno de tus modelos. Un gran ejemplo es la reciente colección Qwen3-VL , que presenta diversas variantes de la arquitectura VL. Prefer safetensors over pickle for weight serialization. : safetensors es más seguro y rápido que pickle o pth de Python. Si tienes un archivo pickle .bin , usa la herramienta de conversión de pesos para convertirlo. Escribir una tarjeta de modelo exhaustiva Una tarjeta de modelo bien elaborada (el README.md de tu repositorio) es esencial para la descubribilidad, la reproducibilidad y el intercambio efectivo. Asegúrate de cubrir: Configuración de metadatos : La sección de metadatos (YAML) en la parte superior de la tarjeta de tu modelo es clave para la búsqueda y la categorización. Incluye: Copiado --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Si creas el README.md en la interfaz web, verás un formulario con los campos de metadatos más importantes que recomendamos 🤗. Formulario de metadatos en la interfaz de usuario del Hub Descripción detallada del modelo : Proporciona una explicación clara de lo que hace tu modelo, su arquitectura y sus casos de uso previstos. Ayuda a los usuarios a decidir rápidamente si se adapta a sus necesidades. Ejemplos de uso : Proporciona fragmentos de código claros, listos para copiar y ejecutar, para inferencia, ajuste fino u otras tareas comunes. Minimiza las ediciones necesarias por parte de los usuarios. Bonus : Añade un notebook.ipynb bien estructurado en el repositorio que muestre inferencia o ajuste fino, para que los usuarios puedan abrirlo directamente en Google Colab y Kaggle Notebooks . Botones de uso de Google y Kaggle Especificaciones técnicas : Incluya los parámetros de entrenamiento, los requisitos de hardware y otros detalles que ayuden a los usuarios a ejecutar el modelo de manera efectiva. Limitaciones y sesgos : Documenta las limitaciones, los sesgos y las consideraciones éticas conocidas para que los usuarios puedan tomar decisiones informadas. Une publication bien réalisée peut accroître la visibilité et l’impact de votre modèle. Cette section détaille les étapes essentielles pour une publication de modèle concise, informative et conviviale. Publier avec un agent de codage ? Installez le hf CLI Skill pour laisser votre agent gérer le téléchargement, la carte du modèle et les métadonnées à votre place. ⏳ Préparation de votre modèle pour sa publication Télécharger les poids du modèle Lors de la mise en ligne de modèles sur le Hub, suivez ces bonnes pratiques : Utiliser des dépôts distincts pour différents poids de modèles : Créez des dépôts individuels pour chaque variante d'une même architecture. Cela vous permet de les regrouper dans une collection , plus facile à parcourir qu'une liste de répertoires. Cela améliore également la visibilité, car chaque modèle possède sa propre URL ( hf.co/org/model-name ), facilite la recherche et fournit des compteurs de téléchargements pour chacun de vos modèles. Un excellent exemple est la récente collection Qwen3-VL , qui présente diverses variantes de l'architecture VL. Privilégiez safetensors plutôt que pickle pour la sérialisation des poids. : safetensors est plus sûr et plus rapide que pickle ou pth de Python. Si vous disposez d'un fichier pickle .bin , utilisez l' outil de conversion des poids pour le convertir. Rédiger une fiche de modèle complète Une fiche de modèle bien conçue (le README.md de votre dépôt) est essentielle pour la découvrabilité, la reproductibilité et le partage efficace. Assurez-vous de couvrir : Configuration des métadonnées : La section metadata (YAML) en haut de votre carte de modèle est essentielle pour la recherche et la catégorisation. Incluez : Copié --- pipeline_tag: text-generation # Specify the task library_name: transformers # Specify the library language: - en # List languages your model supports license: apache-2.0 # Specify a license datasets: - username/dataset # List datasets used for training base_model: username/base-model # If applicable (your model is a fine-tune, quantized, merged version of another model) tags: # Add extra tags which would make the repo searchable using the tag - tag1 - tag2 --- Si vous créez le README.md dans l’interface web, vous verrez un formulaire avec les champs de métadonnées les plus importants que nous recommandons 🤗. Formulaire de métadonnées dans l’interface utilisateur du Hub Description détaillée du modèle : Fournissez une explication claire de ce que fait votre modèle, de son architecture et de ses cas d’usage prévus. Aidez les utilisateurs à décider rapidement s’il répond à leurs besoins. Exemples d'utilisation : Fournissez des extraits de code clairs, prêts à être copiés et exécutés, pour l'inférence, le fine-tuning ou d'autres tâches courantes. Limitez au minimum les modifications nécessaires de la part des utilisateurs. Bonus : ajoutez un notebook.ipynb bien structuré dans le dépôt, illustrant l’inférence ou l’ajustement fin, afin que les utilisateurs puissent l’ouvrir directement dans Google Colab et Kaggle Notebooks . Boutons d'utilisation Google et Kaggle Spécifications techniques : Incluez les paramètres d’entraînement, les besoins matériels et autres détails qui aident les utilisateurs à exécuter le modèle de manière efficace. Métriques de performance : Partagez les résultats des benchmarks et des évaluations. Incluez des métriques quantitatives et des exemples qualitatifs pour illustrer les forces et les limites. Limitations et biais : Documentez les limitations, les biais et les considérations éthiques connus afin que les utilisateurs puissent faire des choix éclairés. Pour rendre le processus plus fluide, cliquez sur Import model card template pour préremplir les README.md avec des espaces réservés. Cette intégration augmente considérablement l’accessibilité de votre modèle et fournit aux utilisateurs des extraits de code pour travailler avec votre modèle. Par exemple, pour indiquer que votre modèle fonctionne avec la bibliothèque transformers : Copié --- library_name: transformers --- Onglet de fragment de code Vous pouvez également enregistrer votre propre bibliothèque de modèles ou ajouter la prise en charge du Hub à votre bibliothèque et à votre base de code, afin que les utilisateurs sachent comment télécharger les poids des modèles depuis le Hub. Сервис работает на базе Inference Providers, с ежемесячными включёнными кредитами для пользователей PRO и организаций Team & Enterprise. Inference Providers предоставляют разработчикам упрощённый и единый доступ к сотням моделей машинного обучения, обеспечиваемый лучшими партнёрами в области serverless-инференса. 👉 Полная документация доступна в документации Inference Providers . Inference Providers на Hub Inference Providers глубоко интегрирован с Hugging Face Hub, и вы можете использовать его несколькими способами: Интерактивные виджеты — тестируйте модели непосредственно на страницах моделей с помощью интерактивных виджетов, которые используют Inference Providers. Пример — страница модели DeepSeek-R1-0528 . Inference Playground — легко тестируйте и сравнивайте модели завершения диалога с вашими запросами. Начните с Inference Playground . Поиск — отфильтруйте модели по провайдеру инференса на странице моделей , чтобы найти модели, доступные через конкретных провайдеров. Data Studio — используйте ИИ для изучения наборов данных на Hub. Попробуйте Data Studio на вашем любимом наборе данных. Создание с помощью провайдеров инференса Вы можете интегрировать Inference Providers в собственные приложения с помощью наших SDK или HTTP-клиентов. Ниже приведено краткое руководство по началу работы на Python и JavaScript; подробные сведения доступны в документации Inference Providers . python javascript Вы можете использовать наш Python SDK для взаимодействия с Inference Providers. Скопировано from huggingface_hub import InferenceClient import os client = InferenceClient( api_key=os.environ[ "HF_TOKEN" ], provider= "auto" , # Automatically selects best provider ) # Chat completion completion = client.chat.completions.create( model= "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324" , messages=[{ "role" : "user" , "content" : "A story about hiking in the mountains" }] ) # Image generation image = client.text_to_image( prompt= "A serene lake surrounded by mountains at sunset, photorealistic style" , model= "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev" ) Или же можно просто использовать клиент, совместимый с API OpenAI. Скопировано import os from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI( base_url= "https://router.huggingface.co/v1" , api_key=os.environ[ "HF_TOKEN" ], ) completion = client.chat.completions.create( model= "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324" , messages=[ { "role" : "user" , "content" : "A story about hiking in the mountains" } ], ) Клиент, совместимый с API OpenAI, не поддерживает генерацию изображений. Вы можете использовать наш JavaScript SDK для взаимодействия с Inference Providers. Скопировано import { InferenceClient } from "@huggingface/inference" ; const client = new InferenceClient (process. env . HF_TOKEN ); const chatCompletion = await client. chatCompletion ({ provider : "auto" , // Automatically selects best provider model : "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324" , messages : [{ role : "user" , content : "Hello!" }] }); const imageBlob = await client. textToImage ({ model : "black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev" , inputs : "A serene lake surrounded by mountains at sunset, photorealistic style" , }); Или же можно просто использовать клиент, совместимый с API OpenAI. Скопировано import { OpenAI } from "openai" ; const client = new OpenAI ({ baseURL : "https://router.huggingface.co/v1" , apiKey : process. env . HF_TOKEN , }); const completion = await client. chat . completions . create ({ model : "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct" , messages : [{ role : "user" , content : "A story about hiking in the mountains" }], }); Клиент, совместимый с API OpenAI, не поддерживает генерацию изображений. Вам понадобится токен Hugging Face с правами на инференс. Создайте его в разделе Settings > Tokens . Как работает Inference Providers Чтобы узнать больше о Inference Providers, обратитесь к документации Inference Providers . Ниже приведены основные ресурсы: Быстрый старт Руководство по тарифам и выставлению счетов Детали интеграции с Hub Что такое HF-Inference API? HF-Inference API — один из провайдеров, доступных через Inference Providers. Ранее он назывался «Inference API (serverless)» и работает на базе Inference Endpoints . Для получения более подробной информации о провайдере HF-Inference см. его специальную страницу . Update on GitHub ← Примеры виджетов Статистика загрузок моделей →
